summary: My first engineering job. I spent most of my time on the two products customers and riders used every day: the DeliveryHobe storefront and the React Native app delivery riders work from. Later I moved to AdsHobe, the company's ads platform, and built its frontend from scratch.

projects.title: DeliveryHobe Storefront
projects.what: The customer-facing web store where people browse products and place delivery orders. I worked heavily on its frontend.
built: Built and maintained storefront pages for browsing products and placing orders.
Connected the frontend to the ordering and delivery APIs.

projects.title: Delivery Rider App
projects.what: A React Native app riders use to pick up and deliver orders.
built: Built rider screens for receiving, picking up and completing deliveries.
Shipped releases of the app to riders in the field.

projects.title: AdsHobe Ads Platform
projects.what: A B2B platform where businesses create and manage ad campaigns. I joined after the storefront and rider app work and architected its frontend from scratch.
built: Set up the frontend architecture, project structure and shared components.
Built the screens businesses use to set up and manage their campaigns.
